candidates.name: 中信证券

baselineEvidence.claim: Domestic IPO underwriting count was zero while IPOs were suspended; the company completed RMB27.48bn of refinancing underwriting with 11.46% market share, ranking first.
The investment-banking franchise remained a core business and the company was market-leading in equity and bond underwriting.

candidates.mechanicalBridge: Regulatory reopening creates a previously blocked equity-underwriting product channel immediately; the company already has leading underwriting distribution/capability.
risks: IPO restart can drain secondary-market liquidity
fee realization timing depends on pipeline allocation
investment banking is only one part of group earnings

baselineEvidence.claim: Investment banking generated RMB336m revenue and RMB132m profit in H1 while IPO remained suspended; the firm completed 21 equity/bond lead-underwriting projects.
